description: Three-level taxonomy for AMC 8/10/12 style problems: domain (level 1) -> topic (level 2) -> tag (level 3). Drafted by the repo owner, not an official MAA standard.

levels.1: domain - the mutually exclusive big bucket used for share-of-paper statistics
levels.2: topic - the primary knowledge point a question is filed under
levels.3: tag - fine-grained reusable problem type, freely multi-selectable

conventions.primary: level-2 topic when it is decisive, otherwise the single most specific level-3 tag; never a level-1 domain
conventions.methods_axis: root 'methods' holds cross-topic techniques; it is a method tag axis, not a knowledge domain, and may be combined with any knowledge domain
conventions.synonyms: one canonical id per concept; alternative names live in the node's 'aliases' array, never as extra ids
conventions.granularity: level-3 tags must be reusable across years; do not invent a tag per question
conventions.difficulty: kept as a separate field on the question (easy/medium/hard), never baked into the taxonomy
